services.name: Our Exhibits
services.desc: Our thoughtfully curated exhibits invite children to splash, climb, build, pretend, create, and discover at their own pace. Designed for different ages, interests, and abilities, our exhibits blend joyful, hands-on fun with meaningful learning, offering experiences that spark curiosity, build confidence, and celebrate the power of play. services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: In the heart of downtown Tampa, Glazer Children’s Museum offers a one-of-a-kind riverfront setting where imagination meets impact. Our playful yet polished spaces turn meetings, celebrations, and gatherings into memorable experiences that feel fresh, creative, and distinctly Tampa. From our light-filled lobby and flexible classrooms to immersive exhibit spaces and a scenic outdoor terrace, the Museum offers stunning views of Curtis Hixon Waterfront Park, the Hillsborough River, the University of Tampa, and downtown Tampa’s skyline.
